title: How Memories Are Made
thumbnailPrompt: Close-up of a human eye reflecting a vibrant, abstract landscape composed of swirling colors and light. The colors appear almost like paint strokes, highlighting the idea of the brain 'painting' the world. Dramatic cinematic lighting with a shallow depth of field.
infographicPrompts: Diagram illustrating the process of light entering the eye, stimulating photoreceptor cells (rods and cones), and sending signals to the brain for color interpretation. Clean, high-contrast style. Focus on clarity of flow.

Conceptual 3D rendering of the brain with different regions highlighted, each representing a stage in memory formation (encoding, storage, retrieval). Neural pathways glow with light, emphasizing the interconnectedness. Modern, minimalist aesthetic.

Flowchart showing the relationship between sensory input, short-term memory, and long-term memory. Use abstract geometric shapes and contrasting colors to represent each stage. Clean lines and a clear visual hierarchy. Focus on how sensory input leads to memory.
